topic: Knowledge base documentation and content consolidation
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on the need to consolidate and update internal knowledge base (KB) information, as much of the existing Pre-Sales material is outdated. Someone offered to gather current information into a central location.

Regarding technical development, it was noted that a support agent has been pre-released to staging for testing, and work on campaigns needs to be done. The MCP protocol knowledge will eventually be added to the API but is currently irrelevant as only the support agent is active.

Several links and folders were shared containing documentation materials intended for inclusion in the KB.
decisions: The existing Pre-Sales information is largely outdated and needs updating.
Knowledge base content should be consolidated into a single, central location.
action_items: Someone will gather current information to update the knowledge base.
Documentation materials were shared via Google Drive links for KB consolidation.
